name: Exact small K/V pair fusion without changing existing kernels
registration: Before any pair-fusion timing; based on the user's request to isolate small K/V improvements
baseline: Full eligible fused vendor pool with own twins, plus separate native Torch K and V arms with their own twin. Vendor algorithm discovery is outside timing.
fusion_comparison: Fixed fused torch.mm route vs separate torch.mm K/V; saves one projection only, no custom-kernel attribution
custom_comparison: Fixed existing coded R2 kernel vs fastest eligible fused vendor, original raw paired-template and oracle gates
measurement: GPU graph replay only; all weight concatenation/packing outside timing; no output copies for M1. >=80MiB distinct original physical pair weights, 31 paired randomized rounds, original best-vendor bootstrap.
acceptance: Numerics, exact input bits, stable Performance/AC context, vendor own abs(A/A)<=1%, paired95% lower saved-latency bound>10% for every registered confirmation case; no rerun until pass
large_case_regression: Before production integration, compare unchanged large gate + separateKV with unchanged large gate + fusedKV; require paired95% lower saved-latency bound>=-1%
unsupported_scope: No individual-projection, M>1, eager, attention, full-model, unlocked or energy claim
